input.summary: Insert a TrueLink performance warranty (professional and workmanlike services for 90 days; 12-month software conformance to documentation; compliance with laws; no malicious code) with repair/replacement, re-performance or refund remedies.
input.comment: [Playbook] TrueLink's only performance warranty today is the Year 2000 clause in Section 9, so we have added our standard warranty set - professional and workmanlike Services for ninety (90) days, twelve (12) months of software conformance to documentation, compliance with laws and no malicious code - with repair or replacement, re-performance or refund of fees as the remedy. If helpful, we can fall back to 90 days for the software and 30 days for the Services with the same remedies.

ops.text: TrueLink further represents and warrants that (i) for ninety (90) days following performance, the Hosting Services and Support Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner consistent with industry standards; (ii) for twelve (12) months following delivery, the Interface and all related software will conform in all material respects to its documentation; (iii) TrueLink will comply with all applicable laws in performing this Agreement; and (iv) the Interface, all related software and all materials delivered to Client hereunder are free of viruses, worms, Trojan horses and other malicious code. For breach of this warranty, TrueLink will, at its option, repair or replace the non-conforming software, re-perform the non-conforming services, or refund the fees paid for them.
